profile.headline: Lead Staff Software Engineer | React & React-Native | Team Lead | TDD & E2E | Jest
profile.summary: I'm a self-taught programmer with a passion for solving complex problems with logic and programming. Coding is not just a job it's also a hobby, from microcontrollers to game dev programming is an amazing way to solve problems and have fun.

positions.title: Lead Sr. Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: expo · Jest · Project Management · E-Commerce · Team Leadership · User Acceptance Testing · React Native

positions.title: React Developer
positions.description:
Built Full-Stack web application and ERP systems with a team of four:
- Frontend: React + React-Query | Cypress | Styled Components | and whatever else was needed,
- Backend: Microsoft Azure
- Database: Cosmos DB,
- Hosting: Firebase,
- Collaboration: Slack, GitHub PR's, Linear.
- QA: Cypress Tests on Github PR's

positions.title: Production & Automation
positions.description:
-Automated Microsoft Excel sheets with functions (e.g., IF, MATCH, INDEX, etc).
-Built local web apps to provide calculations to production teams.
-Improved speed and workflow by automating tasks in JavaScrip

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-Developed fully working wireframes from Photoshop mockups using HTML and JavaScript.
-Managed and updated Trello boards for feature tracking.
-Directed agile scrum meetings to keep up the workflow and provide visibility to other team members.
-Built landing pages to collect user information for the company’s email marketing list.
-Integrated Google Analytics to enhance tracking user interactions.
-Migrate web page analytics to Mixpanel API. 
-Integrated Wave and Wavesurfer into the website to visualize audio files and sound packs for users.

positions.title: CNC Machinist, High Frequency Welder
positions.description:
-Increased CNC machine productivity 200% by simplifying G-code programs, removing redundant actions from the CNC, and increasing the area of use on the AXYZ machine.
-Assisted the engineer by checking blueprints for inaccuracies, drafting new blueprints, and applying changes to existing designs.
-Drafted multi-view drawings, and used these drawings to build new G-code programs.
-Removed manual steps for employees by automating standard operating procedure tasks in G-code.
